get_working_directory.desc: Return the server's current working directory, OS, hostname, and a compact environment summary. Call this first to orient yourself before navigating the filesystem — most other tools default to the server's current working directory.

run_command.desc: Execute a shell command and return combined stdout+stderr. Defaults to sh -c on Unix and cmd /C on Windows, but shell can be set to sh, bash, cmd, powershell, or pwsh for quoting/heredoc-heavy scripts. This is non-interactive and does not allocate a PTY, so TUI/full-screen prompts may fail or hang until timeout; use stdin for scripted input and detach=true for long-running services. Output is captured with a default cap to avoid flooding AI context. Timeout default: 60 s, max: 600 s.

params.command: Command string to execute. Chain with && / ; / | as needed. Quote arguments containing spaces.
params.cwd: Working directory. Defaults to server's working directory.
params.timeout_seconds: Seconds before killing the command, including fractional seconds. Default: 60, max: 600. Timeout attempts to terminate the process tree.
params.env: Extra environment variables as ["KEY=value", ...]. Merged with current env.
params.max_output_bytes: Truncate output to this many bytes. Default: 262144 (256 KB). Set 0 for unlimited.
params.stdin: Content piped to the command's standard input. Use this for scripted input; interactive prompts/TUIs are not supported because no PTY is allocated.
params.shell: Shell wrapper to use: default, sh, bash, cmd, powershell, or pwsh. Use bash/sh for heredocs and Unix syntax; use powershell/pwsh for PowerShell here-strings on Windows.
params.allow_nonzero_exit: Return non-zero exit codes as success instead of raising an error. Default: false.
params.raw_output: Omit metadata header (command echo, cwd, exit code) — return only stdout/stderr. Use when parsing programmatic output (e.g. JSON). Default: false.
params.detach: Start the process detached for long-running services or watchers. Returns immediately with the PID; output is not captured. Use list_processes to monitor. Ignores timeout_seconds, stdin, and max_output_bytes. Default: false.

open_in_app.desc: Open a file, directory, or URL in the default system application. Non-blocking — returns immediately. Uses open on macOS, xdg-open on Linux, start on Windows. Prefer this over running open/xdg-open/start via run_command.

params.target: File path, directory path, or URL to open.

get_env.desc: Read environment variables. With key, returns that variable's value (secret-like names redacted by default). With filter, returns matching variables. Without key/filter, returns names only by default to avoid flooding context or leaking secrets.

params.key: Exact variable name. Returns its value.
params.filter: Case-insensitive substring. Returns matching variables by name.
params.include_values: Include variable values. Default: true when key or filter is set, false when listing all variables.
params.limit: Maximum variables to return for list/filter modes. Default: 100. Set 0 for unlimited.
params.value_max_bytes: Maximum bytes per value when values are included. Default: 4096. Set 0 for full values.
params.redact_secrets: Redact values for secret-like variable names. Default: true.
